cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That's applause. Our real mission is entertaining base. I'm singing the forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now they've switched off. You've lost our audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. I'm handing you the microphone; refuse me a second verse.

mechanism: A supervises a radio partner by redefining failed transmission as reception, then performance, then rejection training with immediate tasks.
confusable: Celebrating a failure as useful leaves the goal stable; D161 changes what the operation was secretly for.
comparison: Communication and a watch forecast differ from a treasure expedition's physical tests.
seedUse: Keep static, forecast and lost audience, but make how B knows the receiver switched off explicit enough.
